title: Punjab School Education Department Announces 2026 STI Merit List
excerpt: The Punjab School Education Department has released the merit list and interview schedule for School Teacher Interns (STI) Jobs 2026.
body_html:
The Punjab School Education Department has officially released the merit list and interview schedule for School Teacher Interns (STI) positions for the year 2026.

Candidates who applied for these education roles can now check the newly announced details to find their merit status and scheduled interview dates.
